metric_correction: The automatic run called five non-required sources false positives. Human review found that four were relevant copied opinions in explicit dispute questions and should remain as alternative evidence. Only E7-Q29 was truly irrelevant.
finding: Simple message handles solved identifier loss, and line handles made every returned quote mechanically exact. The remaining errors are now narrow and visible: three false EMPTY decisions after correct selection, plus one same-words/different-device false positive.
decision: Do not integrate into the desktop yet. First test a simpler extraction contract that never asks whether an already-selected message answers the whole multi-part question; it should only extract what that one message says, then let the later relevance stage decide.
privacy: The run used only the public synthetic E007 world. No owner memory appears in this audit.
